content.title: NRCC Christiansburg Site| New River Community College
content.text: Welcome to NRCC's Christiansburg Site New River Community College's state-of-the art instructional site in Christiansburg is operating as a STEM Center (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math). An expansion to the Christiansburg site was completed in January 2016, creating additional classrooms and office spaces. The new South Wing includes a DIY lab and classroom, and a graphic arts lab, along with additional classrooms for Workforce Development functions.
